features.title: Member-Operated
features.desc: Entirely volunteer-run. Members maintain the property and have a real say in how it is managed.

features.title: Private & Secure
features.desc: Badge-access gate. Range reserved exclusively for members, guests, and match participants.

features.title: Multiple Disciplines
features.desc: Pistol, rifle, benchrest, silhouette, steel challenge, muzzleloading, air guns & more.

features.title: Youth Programs
features.desc: Committed to educating America's youth in shooting sports and safe gun handling.

disciplines.name: Precision Benchrest
disciplines.desc: Range C — centerfire & rimfire benchrest up to 200 yards.

disciplines.name: USPSA / Steel Challenge
disciplines.desc: Ranges G–L host regular APSC club matches and steel challenge events.

disciplines.name: Silhouette Shooting
disciplines.desc: Ranges D & E — hunter pistol, lever action, and smallbore rifle silhouette.

disciplines.name: Air Guns
disciplines.desc: Indoor 10m air rifle and air pistol (limited access).

disciplines.name: Muzzle Loading
disciplines.desc: Range A supports black powder and junior muzzle loading practice.

disciplines.name: High Power Rifle
disciplines.desc: Range C — monthly high power rifle matches.

joinSteps.label: Sign Up
joinSteps.desc: Email membership to request the application link and fill out your form.

joinSteps.label: Safety Evaluation
joinSteps.desc: One-on-one RSO evaluation. Bring your own firearm.

joinSteps.label: Orientation Class
joinSteps.desc: Sunday afternoon class at the ARC Education Building (~2 hrs).

joinSteps.label: Probationary Period
joinSteps.desc: 6 months + 3 volunteer Work Days to become a full voting member.
